entities.name: Ninnan Santesson
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gertrud Paulina Santesson was a Swedish artist and sculptor. Santesson's monumental sculptures and intimate portraits of her contemporaneous women artists are regarded as her greatest creative triumphs.
